name: roslyn-lsp
description: C# language server via Microsoft's official roslyn-language-server (dotnet global tool, .NET 10). Replaces the official csharp-lsp plugin (csharp-ls broken on this box — see cross-repo docs/research/2026-07-20-csharp-ls-install-hang.md). Never enable alongside csharp-lsp: one plugin must own .cs.
